How this was tested

Historical simulation in MetaTrader 5 on XAUUSD (gold), 1 January 2020 to 8 October 2026. Starting balance $100,000, leverage 1:100, all profits reinvested. Every trade has a stop loss and is sized from the account balance according to the risk profile.

Important

Past performance, real or simulated, does not guarantee future results. Trading leveraged gold contracts carries a high risk of loss, and losses can be larger than those shown. Only trade with money you can afford to lose, at least 20% of it.

FTM PROP · one $100,000 prop account · 1 Jan 2020 to 8 Oct 2026

Prop firm

The story of one $100,000 prop firm account run with the FTM PROP plan for 6.8 years: every challenge, every verification and every funded account, passed or failed. When an account failed, a new $100,000 challenge started the next day.

1 · ChallengeGold and Bitcoin. +10% to pass.
2 · VerificationGold. +5% to pass.
3 · FundedGold. The month pauses at +10%. Profits paid monthly at an 80% split.
Rules5% daily loss limit, 10% maximum loss.
1 · Journey

4 · Funded risk

Plan vs lower risk on the funded account

Lower risk on the funded account loses fewer funded accounts, so fewer challenges are bought, but it pays out less. The plan pays the most.

How this was tested

A historical simulation built from FTM PROP, 1 January 2020 to 8 October 2026, each month run on a fresh $100,000 account. Prop firm rules were applied on closed trades. Live daily-loss rules also count open trades, so live results can be worse.
